(2) **APY** if you are 18–40, NOT an income-tax payer, want long-term guaranteed monthly pension from age 60 (Rs. 1,000–5,000/month), and can commit to regular monthly/quarterly/half-yearly contributions. **Key Warning:** Both schemes strictly exclude income-tax payers—if you or your family members (PM-KISAN) or you (APY) have filed income tax returns, you are ineligible and could face account closure/cancellation. **Not for overlapping groups:** A government employee cannot use either scheme.
